map.三种盒型的展开面积差在哪？: Where do the three box styles differ in unfolded area?
map.长方体盒(rect)侧壁环绕+两端+粘口；插边盒(tuck)多一块翻盖、展开长边: A rectangular box has wall wrap + two ends + glue flaps; a tuck-end box adds flaps so the unfolded length is longer; a tray box has only a bottom + low walls + glue ears and uses the least paper. This tool applies the formula of the selected style - the more complex the style and the more tuck flaps, the larger the unfolded area.
map.出血和粘口为什么计入用纸？: Why are bleed and glue flaps counted in paper usage?
map.出血是裁切安全边（通常 3 mm），避免裁偏露白；粘口是成型时涂胶搭接区，虽被遮: Bleed is the trim safety margin (usually 3 mm) preventing white slivers from mis-cutting; glue flaps are the glued overlap area during assembly, hidden but still consuming board. Quotes should use the net board size including bleed rather than the geometric surface area alone, otherwise paper usage is underestimated by 5%-10%.
map.包装盒展开面积计算工具，按盒型与尺寸计算表面积、展开面积、纸板尺寸与用纸量，支持: The Packaging Box Unfold Area calculator computes surface area, unfolded area, board size and paper usage by box style and dimensions, supporting rectangular, tuck-end and tray boxes.
map.表面积 = 2×(L×W + L×H + W×H)（mm²，六面和）；展开面积按: Surface area = 2×(L×W + L×H + W×H) (mm², sum of six faces); unfolded area depends on the box style: rectangular box 2(L+W)H + 2LW + glue flap×(2H+2W), tuck-end box 2LW + 2(L+W)H + tuck flap×(2L+2W), tray box LW + 2(L+W)H + lid flap×(2L+2W); area including bleed = [unfolded area + (board length + board width)×2×bleed] ÷ 100 (cm²), and the board dimensions add bleed at both ends. Validation: when any of length/width/height is ≤0, prompt to enter valid box dimensions. Criteria: paper area per 1000 units (m²) is also provided as a cutting reference.

Surface area = 2 × (L×W + L×H + W×H) (mm², six faces). Unfolded area by box type: rectangular 2(L+W)H + 2LW + glue × (2H+2W); tuck 2LW + 2(L+W)H + flap × (2L+2W); tray LW + 2(L+W)H + flap × (2L+2W). Bleed area uses bounding-rectangle expansion = [unfolded area + 2 × (board length + board width) × bleed + 4 × bleed²] ÷ 100 (cm²); board dimensions add bleed at both ends. The bounding rectangle slightly overestimates irregular outlines; actual die-line offset is separate. Validation: if L, W or H is ≤ 0, prompt for reasonable box dimensions. Reference: 1,000-piece paper area (m²) is a material-planning estimate.
map.托盘盒展开长须包含两侧侧高 H：板长 = L + 2H + 2×粘口，板宽 =: The tray blank length must include both side heights H: board length = L + 2H + 2× glue, board width = W + 2H + 2× glue. For tall side walls, do not use L + 2× glue alone.
map.含出血面积按外接矩形四边扩边并补四角：展开面积 + 2×(板长+板宽)×出血 +: Bleed is added around the bounding rectangle and at its four corners: unfolded area + 2 × (board length + board width) × bleed + 4 × bleed². Irregular outlines differ from a true die-line offset.
map.每 1000 个用纸面积只作备料参考，实际须按拼版、咬口、间隙与损耗另算。: The 1,000-piece paper area is a material-planning reference only; actual usage must include imposition, gripper, gaps and waste.
